concepts.prompt: Create one polished standalone widescreen game UI concept screenshot, not a collage, for a melancholic illustrated dark fantasy narrative game. Faithful to supplied existing art and restrained interface: muted cold gray blue water, earthy ochre reeds, weathered materials, delicate antique gold serif UI, translucent charcoal dialogue region along bottom with circular portrait at lower left. No modern dashboard, no neon, no permanent hope/fatalism meter, no giant floating loot beams. Keep environmental detail sharp. This is a design proposal, not a final game screenshot. Any newly added short UI labels must be bilingual Russian/Ukrainian, Russian first and Ukrainian beneath in smaller type. Avoid long dialogue text; only specified short text. Concept 1: Transition to playable shoreline. Use reference 1 as the exact environmental layout: water across upper part, sandy clearing center, reeds left and right, path down bottom. Reference 2 ONLY supplies portrait and UI styling, not camera. Slightly overhead playable view. A small impoverished dark-haired boy Esteros in muted worn clothes stands near the shoreline with a simple water vessel, realistic tiny scale relative to broad shore. One subtle thin cream hover outline around a reed/root patch at lower left, with tiny interaction tag 'Осмотреть / Оглянути'. A modest upper-left quest notification reads 'Выжить' and below 'Вижити'; small objective 'Раздобыть еды / Здобути їжу'. Bottom portrait bar caption 'Эстерос · мысли / Естерос · думки', no invented speech. Small unobtrusive map-item icon bottom right. Show exploration with one selected environmental object; mostly unobstructed scene.

This shows remembered nearby food-search locations becoming selectable, not a quest-filled world map.

Concept 3: Environmental discovery in a small bleak marsh backwater, using reference 1 terrain rendering style and reference 2 UI/portrait. Overhead playable scene with small boy near foreground muddy trail, low reed water pools, few bare willow trunks and narrow strips of land; sparse forest. Initially inviting patch of reeds/roots in foreground. In the far upper-right, behind broken reeds, an abandoned wooden cart with a couple of fully covered human-sized shrouded bundles lying beside it, suggesting bodies dumped during an epidemic. NO exposed bodies, blood, wounds or gore. Wheel tracks lead from foreground toward cart. Restrained tiny dark fly specks near distant shrouds only, no horror monster. No reward popup, no stat meter, no written diagnosis of cause of death. Preserve large quiet readable playable space.
